PM Modi attends 'bhajan clubbing' on Deendayal Upadhyaya's birth anniversary

Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended an event described as 'bhajan clubbing' on the birth anniversary of Deendayal Upadhyaya. The event took place at Deendayal Upadhyay Park. A video of the Prime Minister's attendance was shared.
